name: plans the sign-out path (null, a manual sign-in, a capture) for an account without a saved sign-in

steps.title: Close the Riot Client
steps.detail: Skipped: RiotClientServices.exe is not running.

steps.title: Save the outgoing sign-in
steps.detail: RiotGamesPrivateSettings.yaml holds Main's sign-in and it changed since it was last saved (the client rotates the token at every start); store the file, encrypted, as the account's saved sign-in if it changed. Nothing in the client's files changes.

steps.title: Back up RiotGamesPrivateSettings.yaml
steps.detail: Copy {tmp}\Local\Riot Games\Riot Client\Data\RiotGamesPrivateSettings.yaml, encrypted, into a new snapshot folder so a failed switch can be rolled back. The newest 20 snapshots are kept.

changes.before: (saved sign-in for Riot account …1111, fingerprint acd093bd)

steps.title: Sign the client out
steps.detail: Set psl.authorization.riot-client to null, the state the client itself writes at a sign-out, and leave every other line (the device cookie included) as it is, so the client opens on its login page instead of signing in as Main.

steps.title: Start the Riot Client
steps.detail: Start the client with no arguments. With no saved sign-in it opens on its login page.

steps.title: Wait for the client to come up
steps.detail: Poll the process list until RiotClientServices.exe is running, up to 0.04 s.

steps.title: Confirm the client signed in
steps.detail: Read what the client appends to its new run log until it reports a sign-in verdict. With no saved sign-in it opens on its login page, so this goes straight to the next step.

steps.title: Wait for you to sign in
steps.detail: The client opens on its login page. Sign in there as riot_new with “Stay signed in” ticked (the password can be copied from One Launch). One Launch continues as soon as the log reports the sign-in, up to 0.0013333333333333333 min. Signing in as a different Riot account than the one linked to New ends the switch and puts the file back.

steps.title: Save the new sign-in
steps.detail: Once the sign-in is reported, wait up to 0.04 s for the client to write RiotGamesPrivateSettings.yaml, then store the file, encrypted, as New's saved sign-in and record the Riot account id on the account. If the client writes it later, it is saved at the next switch instead. Later switches use the saved sign-in.

warnings: No sign-in is saved for New yet. The client will open on its login page; sign in once with “Stay signed in” ticked and One Launch saves it for later switches.
